第17章 暴揍赌鬼赵强，不懂人情世故的李青山-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“青山，你什么时候学的射箭？”

“而且，就这两天，你们怎么遇到这么多野物的？”

大壮爹望着眼前满满当当，层层堆叠的野物，眼睛都看直了，实在是不敢相信，这么多野物是两个第一次上山的新人能够办到的。

就算是村子里的赵占山，那个混在老林子里面十几年的老猎户，也不可能两天之内有这个战绩吧？

“爹，你是不知道山哥的厉害，五十米之内的野物，百发百中，就算是百米之内的野兔，野鸡，也完全不在话下。”

“我感觉，我山哥就是这十里八乡，最厉害的猎户了。”

“以后，绝对是咱们这的炮头。”

大壮毫不吝啬自己的言语，对李青山大加推崇和夸赞道：“爹，我记得咱家还有个表妹未婚吧，不妨给我山哥介绍介绍，以后绝对能过上好日子。”

“哥，你说青莲表妹吗？”

“上个月我才在宋家村见到表妹，老姨夫还问我们村有没有合适的年轻小伙子呢！”

二壮也开口道：“山哥，我家青莲表妹长得可水灵了，你要是见到了，肯定也喜欢。”

望着地上的猎物。

此刻的二壮，心中对李青山也是满满的崇拜，实在是太厉害了，要是自家表妹能够嫁给山哥，那才是真的好嘞。

然而。

大壮和二壮话音落下，便见站在一旁的王春晓面色有些僵硬和小怨气。

大壮爹作为一个中年人。

如何会和自家两个儿子一样莽撞，见李青山身侧的王春晓脸上流露出一抹不悦之色，大概也就猜出了个七七八八。

当即对着自家俩儿子狠狠瞪了一眼。

旋即道：“就你们话多，自己的婆娘还没弄明白，就想着给别人介绍了，先管好你们两个单身汉自己吧！”

大壮和二壮相互对视一眼，挠了挠头，升起一抹尴尬。

不再说话。

“青山，就凭咱们几个人，这么多野物可不好带回去啊，现在要是再回村喊人，肯定又要耽搁不少时间了。”

大壮爹望着堆在地上的野物道。

“财叔，待会咱们几个将这些野物的皮毛全部剥下来，现场处理一下挂好，老林子一时半会也不会再落雨了，等着下次来取便是！”

“还有狍子的骨头，也都剔出来埋了！”

“咱们只带着肉回去，五个人想必是够了的。”

“而且，你们来的这一路，肯定也饿坏了，待会烤些兔子和野鸡，又会少掉一些。”

李青山开口道。

“咦！”

“这，倒是可以！”

李青山话音落下，大壮和大壮爹他们，眼前一亮，在李青山的指挥下开始忙活起来，剥皮，剔骨……！

“青山，你这箭射的也太准了！”

“全部都射中的脖子，浑身上下的皮毛没有一点损伤，这样的皮毛拿去卖，可是能卖不少钱嘞！”

将狍子和野兔吊挂起来剥皮的时候，财叔发现了这个情况，眼神中满是对李青山的赞赏。

能够将射箭练到这个程度的。

李财真的是前所未见，就算是赵占山，包括周围几个村子的猎户，也没有李青山这般的手段啊！！

这小子，真是不简单。

这么多年，一直都深藏不露不成？

此刻！

李财的心情有些复杂起来，要不要让大壮继续跟着李青山，这小子看起来比那些老猎户还要厉害。

很快。

所以狍子和野兔全部剥皮，三只狍子的骨头被剃了大半，一些小骨头就算了，毕竟大家也不是专业剔骨的，能勉强将骨头剔出来，就已经十分不错了。

剔出来的骨头全部扔到火堆烧了！

剥下来的皮毛则是找了一处有太阳的地方，高高挂了起来，上面的脂肪都简单处理过，这一点李青山前世没少干，倒是专业的很。

几只野鸡和野兔，很快放在火堆上炙烤起来。

当闻着空气中散发出浓郁肉香的野鸡和野兔后，李财终于是下定了决心，日后还是让大壮跟着李青山一起玩。

“爹，真香啊！”

“我都大半年没吃过肉了。”

二壮一脸期待的望着烤兔肉道。

“你看你那点出息！”李财对着自家小儿子骂了一声，然后忍不住暗自咽了口口水。

不得不说，真香啊！！

自己两个儿子大半年没吃肉了，自己何尝也不是大半年没吃肉了啊！！

李青山将烤好的野兔和山鸡给大家分了。

这绝对是二壮和李财这辈子吃过，最香，最值得回味的一顿饭。

以往，逢年过节。

家中虽然有肉，但不多，而且是一家人吃，都要克制着去吃，不能吃多了，一人最多尝个几口，刚刚将味道尝出来，就没有了。

感觉心被猫挠一样。

但是今天，肉管够，随便吃，什么时候这么奢侈过？

吃饱饭后。

李财看向了自家小儿子，下次李青山上山，要不要让二壮也跟着来？

吃饱喝足后。

五个人拎着肉，开始朝着石溪村的方向赶去，山路崎岖并不好走，但是大家出发的比较早，天黑之前应该是能到家的。

下午五点钟的时候。

李青山和王春晓等人，终于是到了石溪村。

村头。

不少村子里的汉子正在胡侃吹牛，这里也是大家农闲时候的聚集地，路两旁放了几个石墩子，有些人则是从家中搬着小椅子，还有的人直接靠着墙角便直接蹲坐下去。

"Qingshan, when did you learn archery?"

"Besides, how did you encounter so many wild animals in the past two days?"

Dad Zhuang's eyes widened when he looked at the piles of wild animals in front of him. He really couldn't believe that two newcomers who were going up the mountain for the first time could handle so many wild animals.

Even Zhao Zhanshan in the village, the old hunter who has been in the old forest for more than ten years, can't achieve this result in two days, right?

"Dad, you don't know how powerful Brother Shan is. He can hit wild animals within fifty meters with perfect accuracy, even hares and pheasants within a hundred meters."

"I feel that my brother Shan is the most powerful hunter in this ten miles apart."

"From now on, he will definitely be our leader."

Da Zhuang was not stingy with his words and praised and praised Li Qingshan: "Dad, I remember that there is an unmarried cousin in our family. You might as well introduce me to Brother Shan, and you will definitely live a good life in the future."

"Brother, are you talking about cousin Qinglian?"

"I just met my cousin in Songjiacun last month, and my old uncle asked if there were any suitable young men in our village!"

Erzhuang also said: "Brother Shan, my cousin Qinglian is so pretty. If you see her, you will definitely like her too."

Looking at the prey on the ground.

At this moment, Erzhuang also admires Li Qingshan in his heart. He is really awesome. It would be really good if his cousin could marry Brother Shan.

However.

After Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang finished speaking, they saw Wang Chunxiao standing aside with a stiff and slightly resentful look on his face.

Da Zhuang Dad is a middle-aged man.

How could he be as reckless as his two sons? Seeing a look of displeasure on Wang Chunxiao's face next to Li Qingshan, he probably guessed something.

He immediately glared hard at his two sons.

Immediately he said: "You are the only ones who talk a lot. My mother-in-law hasn't figured it out yet, so she wants to introduce it to others. You two bachelors should take care of yourselves first!"

Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang looked at each other, scratched their heads, and felt a sense of embarrassment.

No more talking.

"Qingshan, just the few of us can't bring back so many wild animals. If we go back to the village to call for help now, it will definitely take a lot of time."

Da Zhuang Daddy looked at the wild animals piled on the ground and said.

"Uncle Cai, we will peel off all the furs of these wild animals later and hang them up on site. There won't be any more rain in the old forest for a while. We'll wait to pick them up next time!"

"The bones of the roe deer were also picked out and buried!"

"Let's go back with only meat. It must be enough for five people."

"Besides, you must have been hungry all the way here. You will roast some rabbits and pheasants later, and you will lose some."

Li Qingshan said.

"Eh!"

"This is fine!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, Da Zhuang and Da Zhuang's father's eyes lit up. Under Li Qingshan's command, they began to work, skinning and deboning...!

"Qingshan, your arrow is so accurate!"

"The neck was all shot, but the fur all over the body was not damaged at all. If you sell such fur, you can get a lot of money!"

When hanging the roe deer and hare to skin them, Uncle Cai noticed this and his eyes were full of admiration for Li Qingshan.

Someone who can practice archery to this level.

Li Cai has really never seen it before. Even Zhao Zhanshan, including the hunters from several surrounding villages, does not have such methods as Li Qingshan!!

This boy is really not simple.

Have you kept it secret for so many years?

now!

Li Cai's mood became a little complicated. Should he let Da Zhuang continue to follow Li Qingshan? This kid seemed to be even more powerful than those old hunters.

soon.

Therefore, all the roe deer and hares were skinned, and most of the bones of the three roe deer were shaved off. Some small bones were left alone. After all, we are not professional deboners. If we can barely pick out the bones, it is already very good.

All the bones picked out were thrown into the fire and burned!

The peeled fur was found in a sunny place and hung high. The fat on it was simply treated. This was something Li Qingshan had done many times in his previous life, and he was very professional.

Several pheasants and hares were quickly roasted on the fire.

After smelling the rich meaty aroma of pheasants and hares in the air, Li Cai finally made up his mind to let Da Zhuang play with Li Qingshan in the future.

"Dad, it smells so good!"

"I haven't eaten meat in more than half a year."

Er Zhuang looked at the roasted rabbit with anticipation.

"Look at your potential!" Li Cai cursed at his youngest son, and then couldn't help but swallowed secretly.

I have to say, it smells really good!!

My two sons haven’t eaten meat for more than half a year, and I haven’t eaten meat for more than half a year!!

Li Qingshan shared the roasted hare and pheasant with everyone.

This was definitely the most delicious and memorable meal Er Zhuang and Li Cai had ever eaten in their lives.

In the past, it was a festival.

Although there is meat at home, it is not much, and it is eaten by the whole family, so we must eat with restraint and not eat too much. One person can only taste a few mouthfuls. As soon as the taste is tasted, it is gone.

It feels like my heart is being scratched by a cat.

But today, there is enough meat to eat as much as you want. When has it ever been so luxurious?

After a full meal.

Li Cai looked at his youngest son. Next time Li Qing goes up the mountain, should he ask Er Zhuang to follow him?

After eating and drinking enough.

The five people carried the meat and started to rush towards Shixi Village. The mountain road was rugged and not easy to walk, but everyone started early and should be able to get home before dark.

At five o'clock in the afternoon.

Li Qingshan, Wang Chunxiao and others finally arrived at Shixi Village.

Village head.

Many men in the village were chatting and bragging. This was also where everyone gathered during their off-farm time. There were several stone pillars placed on both sides of the road. Some people moved small chairs from their homes, while others squatted down directly against the corners.
